verdict.rationale: The NVIDIA H200 is a data-center GPU, a piece of hardware. Versioning, reviewing, and rolling back user automations is a software workflow axis that does not apply to this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows the H200 itself ships automation versioning, so the wrong-axis exception does not trigger.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
